_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 6 object handlers: types $22 and $27 ($A0A6-$A26A). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: TYPE $22 (A BEAM PIECE, fired by the bosses): first frame?
regions.description: TYPE $22 (A BEAM PIECE, fired by the bosses): bit 7 set goes to the per-frame code. Stats: hit points 128, attack 0 (the shooter's attack is copied in), collision flags `$4E`, drawing flags 0, dies as type 8.

regions.name: TYPE $22 (A BEAM PIECE, fired by the bosses): set-up
TYPE $22 (A BEAM PIECE, fired by the bosses): every frame
regions.description: `JSR $C129` (`$FB76`, the beam machine of the helper entry: a chain of 16-pixel pieces between the object and its parent, set by the shooter through `$FE3D` / `$FDF8`); carry set (the parent is gone) removes it; else `JSR $C0C0` (`$D279`: the hit test against the player side, mask 4, using the box the beam routine set) and `JMP $C0D5` (`$D2C5`: the consequences of a hit, without the hit sound).

regions.name: TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): first frame?
regions.description: TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): the bullet is a table-driven homing shot. Its KIND is `$07A0` as the shooter left it (0-7); the stats come from eight-entry tables at `$A1EF-$A22F`. Table stats of the type: hit points 0, attack 0 (both replaced), drawing flags `$13`, dies as type 8.

regions.name: TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): the art block
regions.description: `$07B8` := `$A21F[kind]`: the tile block the bullet's pictures live in (`$39 $35 $36 $02 $04 $35 $39 $2F`).

regions.name: TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): find the block
regions.description: `JSR $C0AB` (`$CF68`, the art wait entered with the block in A): the block's base tile goes to `$06C8` / `$07E8`; if it is not loaded the bullet waits and is dropped like any enemy.

regions.name: TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): palette
TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): speed class, re-aim interval
regions.description: `$0698` := `$A1F7[kind]` (`03 41 06 05 03 81 06 41`: the speed class for `$F8CE`) and `$06B0` := `$A1FF[kind]` (`10 0A 08 08 10 05 09 10`: frames between re-aims).

regions.name: TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): two more values
regions.description: `$07D0` := `$A207[kind]` (`03 05 08 07 08 06 06 06`; this handler does not read it again - a lead) and `$0668` := `$A227[kind]` (`01 01 01 02 02 01 01 04`: the turn step).

regions.name: TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): picture mode, hit points
TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): attack
regions.description: `$05A8` := `$A217[kind]` (`04 08 30 40 18 04 04 06`). So kinds 2, 3 and 4 are large shots with 24, 12 and 16 hit points that can be shot down, the others die at once.

regions.name: TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): first velocity
regions.description: `JSR $C0A2`; A := `$0788` (the direction the shooter set) and into the turn code's tail.

regions.name: TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): every frame: the re-aim timer
regions.description: `$07A0` counts down from `$06B0`; non-zero goes to the picture and move (`$A174`).

regions.name: TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): re-aim
regions.description: `JSR $C0FF` (`$F863`): the direction to the player. The difference from `$0788` is 0: no turn. 1-7 (ahead on the clockwise side) adds the turn step `$0668`, 8-15 subtracts it. RUN: each kind spawned alone in a corridor state at (60, 40) heading down with the player at (200, 150), its art block marked loaded, `$41` stepped by hand. Heading down (4) at a player to the lower right (about 2): kind 0 went 4 -> 3 within 16 frames, kind 3 (step 2) 4 -> 2 within 8 and on to 0, kind 7 (step 4) 4 -> 0 within 16.

regions.name: TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): new velocity
regions.description: Direction AND `$0F` into `$0788`, `JSR $C102` (direction to velocity with the speed class).

regions.name: TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): reload the timer
TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): which picture mode
regions.description: `$0680` AND `$7F`: 0 is the direction-driven picture (`$A148`), 1, 2, 3 the others (`$A185`).

regions.name: TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): mode 0: tile offset and flip
regions.description: `$15` := `$A237[direction AND 7]` (`00 04 08 0C 10 0C 08 04`), `$14` := `$A23F[direction / 4]` (`80 C0 40 00`: the flips for the four quadrants).

regions.name: TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): mode 0: which metasprite
regions.description: Metasprite `$19` (25), except `$37` (55) when the direction AND 7 is 4 (straight down or up) and `$0680` has bit 7 set. RUN: metasprite 55 while heading straight down, 25 once it turned.

regions.name: TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): set the picture
regions.description: `JSR $A1D8`.

regions.name: TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): mode 3: flicker
regions.description: `$0680` = 3 (kind 7): the tile offset is `$41 AND 4`, 0 or 4, alternating every four frames.

regions.name: TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): move and fight
regions.description: `JMP $9F4F`: move and draw, the hit test as an ordinary enemy (mask `$30`) and its consequences.

regions.name: TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): mode 1 (kind 3)
regions.description: The direction is held to even values (AND `$0E`); tile offset `$A243[(direction AND 7) / 2]` (`00 06 04 06`), flips `$A247[direction / 2]`; then as mode 0 from `$A15E`.

regions.name: TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): mode 2 (kind 4)
regions.description: Y = direction / 2: `JSR $A1CB` reads the tile offset, flips and metasprite from the three eight-entry tables at `$A24F / $A257 / $A25F` (the metasprites `$4B $19 $1A $19 $4B $7B $7B $7B`: a different bolt for each octant).

regions.name: TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): mode 3 and others
regions.description: Flips `$14` := `$A267[direction / 4]` (`C0 80 00 40`), tile offset unchanged (`$06C8`), metasprite `$19`.

regions.name: TYPE $27 (THE HOMING BULLET, eight kinds): mode 2 table reads
regions.description: `$15` := `$A24F[Y]`, `$14` := `$A257[Y]`, A := `$A25F[Y]`; falls into the picture setter.

regions.name: Picture setter for bullets and enemies (`$A1D8`)
regions.description: A = the metasprite: `$0548,X` := A; `$0560,X` := (`$0560` AND 3) OR `$14` (the flip bits go in the top bits, the palette stays). Many enemy handlers call this.

regions.name: Tile offset setter (`$A1E5`; `$A1E7` with A as the offset)
regions.description: `$06C8,X` := `$15` (or A at `$A1E7`) + `$07E8,X` (the block's base tile). RTS.

Bullet speed class by kind
regions.description: `03 41 06 05 03 81 06 41` (`$F8CE`: bit 7 x8, bit 6 x4, low six bits the count).

regions.name: Bullet re-aim interval by kind
Bullet value for `$07D0` by kind
regions.description: `03 05 08 07 08 06 06 06` (not read again by the bullet's own handler).

Bullet attack by kind

Bullet turn step by kind
Bullet picture mode by kind
regions.description: `80 80 00 81 02 80 80 03` (bit 7 selects the tall metasprite when heading straight).

Bullet flips by quadrant (mode 0)

Bullet flips by direction (mode 1)
